enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping. Turn again. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Splash water on face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take kettle. Fill with water from tap. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Take pan. Place on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. When kettle boils, turn off kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Take toast from toaster. Place on plate. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Stand up. Take dishes to sink. Rinse dishes. Place in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Take work bag. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Place phone in bag. Zip bag. Place bag by door. Turn off fan.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Put phone in pocket. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Pick up phone. Call partner organization. Discuss program details. Take notes. Hang up. Open calendar. Check schedule. Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Discuss program coordination. Take notes. Walk back to desk. Update program schedule. Print documents. File documents. Attend meeting. Present updates. Answer questions. Return to desk. Send follow-up emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to lunch place. Open door. Order food. Pay cashier. Take food tray. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, planning upcoming community events and updating program schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open planning document. Type notes. Make phone calls. Email partners. Update schedule. Print schedule. Attend meeting. Discuss event details. Take notes. Walk to printer. Pick up documents. Return to desk. File documents. Review event budget. Edit schedule. Save document. Close computer. Stand up. Stretch.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to apartment door. Unlock door. Enter apartment.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off cooker. Take plate. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Take dishes to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Turn off tap. Throw away trash. Sweep floor. Put away cleaning supplies.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust pillow. Lie down on sofa. Continue watching TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing program notes on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open program notes. Read notes. Type comments. Highlight text. Save document. Open notebook. Write notes. Close notebook. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and doing night skincare routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out. Dry body with towel. Apply skincare products. Turn off light. Walk out.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping. Turn again. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep.
